(rule!
 ;; Each foreground color is a possibly disconnected silhouette. Background is
 ;; the most frequent color (smallest color on ties). For each silhouette infer
 ;; the vertical axis retaining the most same-color mirror pairs. Count axis
 ;; cells once; take the leftmost doubled axis on ties. Erase unsupported pixels.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define colors (grid-colors g))
   (define background
    (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((color (in-list colors)))
     (if (> (count-color g color) (count-color g best)) color best)))
   (define (axis-for cells)
    (define lo (min-of second cells))
    (define hi (max-of second cells))
    (define scored
     (for/fold ((best (list -1 (* 2 lo)))) ((k (in-range (* 2 lo) (+ 1 (* 2 hi)))))
      (let ((score (count-if (lambda (p) (member (list (first p) (- k (second p))) cells)) cells)))
       (if (> score (first best)) (list score k) best))))
    (second scored))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((color (in-list (grid-colors g background))))
    (let* ((cells (find-color g color)) (axis (axis-for cells)))
     (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (in-list cells)))
      (if (member (list (first p) (- axis (second p))) cells)
          acc
          (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) background))))))))
(rule!
 ;; Each foreground color is a possibly disconnected silhouette. Background is
 ;; the most frequent color (smallest color on ties). For each silhouette infer
 ;; the vertical axis retaining the most same-color mirror pairs. Count axis
 ;; cells once; take the leftmost doubled axis on ties. Fill unsupported reflected background pixels; preserve existing colors.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define colors (grid-colors g))
   (define background
    (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((color (in-list colors)))
     (if (> (count-color g color) (count-color g best)) color best)))
   (define (axis-for cells)
    (define lo (min-of second cells))
    (define hi (max-of second cells))
    (define scored
     (for/fold ((best (list -1 (* 2 lo)))) ((k (in-range (* 2 lo) (+ 1 (* 2 hi)))))
      (let ((score (count-if (lambda (p) (member (list (first p) (- k (second p))) cells)) cells)))
       (if (> score (first best)) (list score k) best))))
    (second scored))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((color (in-list (grid-colors g background))))
    (let* ((cells (find-color g color)) (axis (axis-for cells)))
     (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (in-list cells)))
      (let ((rr (first p)) (cc (- axis (second p))))
       (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (= (at g rr cc) background))
           (set-cell acc rr cc color)
           acc))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Recover per-color vertical symmetry from maximum reflected support.
 ;; The most frequent color is background; ties use the smaller color.
 ;; Each color's axis is a doubled column, so half-cell axes are representable.
 ;; Equal maximum-support axes use the leftmost axis (smallest doubled column).
 ;; Trim unpaired pixels.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (pick-max (range 0 10) (lambda (color) (count-color g color))))
   (define (axis cells)
    (pick-max (range 0 (- (* 2 w) 1))
     (lambda (k)
      (count-if (lambda (p) (member (list (first p) (- k (second p))) cells)) cells))))
   (define records
    (for/list ((color (grid-colors g bg)))
     (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (list color cells (axis cells)))))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w bg))) ((part records))
    (let* ((color (first part)) (cells (second part)) (k (third part))
           (partners (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- k (second p)))) cells))
           (chosen (filter (lambda (p) (member p partners)) cells)))
      (recolor-cells out chosen color))))))
(rule!
 ;; Recover per-color vertical symmetry from maximum reflected support.
 ;; The most frequent color is background; ties use the smaller color.
 ;; Each color's axis is a doubled column, so half-cell axes are representable.
 ;; Equal maximum-support axes use the leftmost axis (smallest doubled column).
 ;; Complete missing partners, preserving the input support; clip at the canvas.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (pick-max (range 0 10) (lambda (color) (count-color g color))))
   (define (axis cells)
    (pick-max (range 0 (- (* 2 w) 1))
     (lambda (k)
      (count-if (lambda (p) (member (list (first p) (- k (second p))) cells)) cells))))
   (define records
    (for/list ((color (grid-colors g bg)))
     (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (list color cells (axis cells)))))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w bg))) ((part records))
    (let* ((color (first part)) (cells (second part)) (k (third part))
           (partners (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- k (second p)))) cells))
           (chosen (remove-duplicates (append cells partners))))
      (recolor-cells out chosen color))))))
